name: privilege-google-secrets
description: Privilege Google Secrets Lab: Privilege Hubs brokering a Google Secret Manager credential to an AI agent. The agent holds only an agent access key; policy allows the in-scope secret and refuses the out-of-scope ask. Mock gateway, custodian and Google Secret Manager, all in-process.
